title: Titanic RandomForest Baseline
subtitle: Scikit-learn RandomForest survival classifier for the Kaggle Titanic competition
description:
# Model Summary
RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn) predicting passenger survival on the Kaggle Titanic dataset. Two variations: `rf-small` (50 trees) and `rf-large` (500 trees), both max_depth=6.

# Model Characteristics
- Input: 7 tabular features (Pclass, Sex, Age, SibSp, Parch, Fare, Embarked) after simple encoding/imputation.
- Output: binary label Survived (0/1) and class probabilities.
- Serialized with pickle.

# Data Overview
Trained on `train.csv` of the Titanic - Machine Learning from Disaster competition (891 rows).

# Evaluation Results
5-fold CV accuracy ~0.82; public leaderboard 0.787 (rf, 300 trees).

# Usage
```python
import pickle
model = pickle.load(open('model.pkl', 'rb'))
model.predict(X)
```

# Limitations
Educational baseline; no hyper-parameter search, minimal feature engineering.
